Topology.title: Azure Hybrid Cloud Hub-Spoke
Topology.Description: Secure hybrid cloud architecture with Azure hub-spoke topology, including a private ARO cluster in the spoke and shared services in the hub, connected to on-premises via ExpressRoute.
Topology.Summary: The hub contains shared services such as a firewall and a bastion host. The spoke network includes a private ARO cluster. The on-premises network has an OCP cluster and databases, connected to the hub via ExpressRoute. Public web traffic is protected by a WAF.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
